summary.en: A stray cat, carrying a piece of paper, appears at the spot where Mitsuhiko is showing off the Kamen Yaiba pin he has accidentally won to his friends. The cat hands the paper to Conan, much to everyone's surprise, revealing that someone needed help. Meanwhile, Sato and Takagi are chasing after the kidnapper of Ishigami Corporation's granddaughter, Shiori, because Sato mistook him for an ordinary illegal parking offender and let him leave without taking a suitcase that the kidnapper should have taken so that Inspector Hatori of the special investigation team could find the girl, potentially endangering her life. The car Sato is driving, chasing the kidnapper's motorcycle, reaches Kanagawa Prefecture, where we see Chihaya Hagiwara handling a traffic case. She also notices the red car speeding and decides to chase after it to see what is happening. The kidnapper is very stubborn, running red lights and honking loudly to scare away all passersby. However, he nearly left a young boy crashed by Sato’s car without Chihaya’s interference, as the boy was left stunned from the chaos and unaware of the car chasing for the motorbike. Just when it seems all hope of catching the culprit has vanished, some subsequent clues suggest to the three officers that the man is hiding in a red-brick warehouse near the scene of the near-accident.
